credit_line: Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: Portrait of Helen and Godfrey Rockefeller, at twilight, sitting in camping chairs in opposite directions, in the woods.  Helen is reading the paper. This photograph is part of an album created by Ansel Adams after his 1938 trip to Yosemite with Georgia O'Keeffe, David McAlpin, and Helen and Godfrey Rockefeller. This is one of only three albums created for his travel companions documenting their trip.
title: A quiet evening at home (Helen and Godfrey Rockefeller)
